## Further reading {#sec-additional-resources}

- @strang2023linear
  is a widely used first course in linear algebra.
  It covers vectors, elimination, vector spaces, orthogonality, determinants,
  eigenvalues, and the singular value decomposition.
- @axler2024linear
  is a proof-based treatment centered on vector spaces and linear maps.
  A free electronic version is available from the publisher.
- @fieller2018basics
- @banerjee2014linear
- @searle2017matrix
- @petersen2012matrix
  is a free desk reference that collects matrix identities:
  it lists results on determinants, inverses, decompositions,
  and derivatives of vectors and matrices,
  so it is a quick place to look up a formula this page proves.
